**Spirit Spire world & progression** (design decided 2026-07-03). Full doc: `SpiritSpire/GAME_MAP.md`. Maps (both generated by scripts — edit the script, not the output): (1) **actual SotN-style grid map screen** `design/tower_map_grid.png` via `python design/gen_tower_map_grid.py` (edit ROOMS/CORRIDORS/GATES — rooms are cells on a grid, gated doors lettered W/F/T/B/R/L/V); (2) schematic progression diagram `design/tower_map.svg` via `python design/gen_tower_map.py`.

- **One open, interconnected tower** explored freely (Castlevania/SotN style), NOT gated linear levels. 7 regions bottom→top: Sunken Root (hub) · Ossuary Stair · Verdant Hollow · Tidewrack Archive · Gilded Mechanism · The Thinning · The Crown. ~32 rooms in the first-pass map.
- **Inverted tower = same geometry flipped vertically + harder** (user's explicit choice — not a separate map, not the Veil-as-second-tower). Cheap to build: remix/re-gate existing rooms.
- **Gating is hybrid:** Phantoms double as traversal keys AND a few relics gate other paths. Phantom keys: Warrior=break cracked walls, Druid=grow vine platforms, Rogue=dash gaps/stealth, Revenant=phase Veil barriers. Relics: Ascendant Feather (double jump), Tidal Charm (underwater), Resonant Bell (wake mechanisms), Spirit Lantern (reveal Veil paths), **Inverted Sigil** (the inversion key item).
- **Bosses are mixed — NOT all grant Phantoms.** Phantom bosses: First Fallen→Warrior, Thornmother→Druid, Hollow Chime→Rogue, Veilwarden→Revenant. Guardian (relic, no phantom): The Curator→Resonant Bell. Healer phantom = optional hidden shrine, not a boss.
- **Two villains (the story spine):** (1) **The Ascendant Shaman** — false final boss at the Crown; a rival shaman using the Spire to absorb the spirit world and ascend to godhood; his ritual is what frays the Veil as you climb. Beat him without the Sigil = false ending. (2) **The Arbiter of Chaos** (name tentative) — true final boss at the inverted summit (old base); the Shaman's ascension was only the lever meant to unseal it. The whole first climb is the Arbiter's plan working.
- **Inversion trigger:** find the hidden Inverted Sigil (in the Sunken Alcove, gated behind a Veil door needing Revenant + Lantern — poetically back at the base), bring it to the Ascendant Shaman → tower flips → descend to the true summit → Arbiter → true ending.
- **Undecided (see GAME_MAP §11):** exact Warden-fight-with-Sigil flow (leaning: flip triggers at low HP), currency/upgrade economy, rooms-per-region count, whether Healer becomes a 6th boss. Arbiter of Chaos name may change.

- **Saving = Totems.** Each save room contains a **Totem**; the player interacts with it to **make an offering**, which is the save action (save-room + save-point object, themed). The room is still the save room; the Totem is the object inside. User will implement the Totem/offering interaction himself later. On the maps the red "save room / Well" cells mark these rooms.

Base game systems this rides on: see [[spirit-spire-project]] (Phantom system, FSM, feel-harness).
